comment: This file covers lore inversions, in lore inversions a piece of lore has its first and second levels swapped

recipes.label: Invert Winter Lore
recipes.startdescription:
As Above, So Below
If I use fascination above and dread below I can swap the aspects of this lore on the great triangle [Winter (AL) becomes Lantern (LA)]
